assertions.assertion: Output calls AddClientCredentialsTokenManagement() to register the token management services
Output calls AddClient() with configuration including TokenEndpoint, ClientId, ClientSecret, and Scope
assertions.rationale: AddClient("catalog", ...) sets TokenEndpoint, ClientId, ClientSecret, and Scope.

assertions.assertion: Output registers an HTTP client using AddClientCredentialsHttpClient or AddClientCredentialsTokenHandler with the client name
assertions.rationale: Registers the "catalog-client" HttpClient via AddClientCredentialsHttpClient referencing the "catalog" client name.

assertions.assertion: Output shows a BackgroundService or worker class that uses IHttpClientFactory.CreateClient to make API calls without manual token code
assertions.rationale: CatalogWorker : BackgroundService calls _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("catalog-client") without any token-fetching code.

assertions.assertion: Output uses v4 strongly-typed ClientCredentialsClientName.Parse() for the client name (not a raw string)
assertions.rationale: Uses raw strings ("catalog") and string property setters throughout; no ClientCredentialsClientName.Parse() or v4 strongly-typed types.
